"""Validate current-build Strider baseline and held-skill travel/reload traces."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
checks, evidence, measurements = {}, {}, {}


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(name):
    p = ROOT / f"private/research/{name}.json"
    d = json.loads(p.read_bytes())
    assert d["ok"]
    evidence[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] = sha(p)
    return d["value"]["trial"]


def every(rows, predicate):
    return bool(rows) and all(predicate(r) for r in rows)


def check(name, value):
    checks[name] = bool(value)


expected = [[152, -1, 150, 351, -1, 353], [150, 152, -1, 353, 351, -1]]
baseline = read("shared-strider-baseline")
rows = baseline["rows"]
check("baseline.clean_complete", not baseline["running"] and not baseline["errors"] and len(rows) > 180)
check("baseline.equipped_loadouts", every(rows, lambda r: r["equipped"] == expected))
check("baseline.offline_healthy_joined", every(rows, lambda r: r["runtime"]["session"] == 2 and r["runtime"]["nativeOffline"] == 1 and r["runtime"]["transport"] == 2 and r["runtime"]["faults"] == r["runtime"]["nativeErrors"] == r["hud"]["failures"] == 0))
for i, p in enumerate(baseline["phases"]):
    hi = baseline["phases"][i+1]["time"] if i+1 < len(baseline["phases"]) else float("inf")
    stable = [r for r in rows if p["time"]+500 <= r["time"] < hi]
    if p["name"] in ("neutral", "p1_primary", "final"):
        check("baseline." + p["name"], every(stable, lambda r: r["skills"]["visible"] == 0 and r["skills"]["ids"] == [-1]*3))
    else:
        secondary = p["name"] in ("pawn_secondary", "both_secondary")
        ids = expected[1][3:] if secondary else expected[1][:3]
        names = ["Cloudburst Volley", "Triad Shot", ""] if secondary else ["Biting Wind", "Scarlet Kisses", ""]
        check("baseline." + p["name"], every(stable, lambda r: r["skills"]["visible"] == 1 and r["skills"]["ids"] == ids and r["skills"]["names"] == names and r["skills"]["blocked"] == 0))

for mode in ("travel", "reload"):
    d = read("shared-" + mode + "-held")
    rows = d["rows"]
    phases = {p["name"]: p["time"] for p in d["phases"]}
    n = mode + "."
    duration = d.get("durationMs", 300000)
    check(n + "clean_bounded", not d["running"] and not d["errors"] and duration in (300000, 600000) and d["elapsedMs"] < duration and 100 < len(rows) < duration/50+100)
    check(n + "same_current_process", d["pid"] == baseline["pid"])
    check(n + "healthy_transport", every(rows, lambda r: r["runtime"]["faults"] == r["runtime"]["nativeErrors"] == r["split"]["faults"] == r["hud"]["failures"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["transport"] == 2))
    check(n + "native_ready_entire_accepted_trace", every(rows, lambda r: r["runtime"]["nativeOffline"] == 1))
    pending = [r for r in rows if r["runtime"]["nativeOffline"] != 1]
    check(n + "offline_ready_for_all_live_control", all(r["runtime"]["session"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["p1"] == r["runtime"]["p2"] == -1 and not any(a["observed"] for a in r["runtime"]["actors"]) and not r["split"]["active"] and not r["hud"]["visible"] for r in pending))
    if mode == "reload":
        check(n + "native_online_option_never_enabled", every(rows, lambda r: r["offline"]["onlineOption"] is False and r["offline"]["saveValid"]))
        check(n + "native_readiness_recovers", rows[-1]["runtime"]["nativeOffline"] == 1 and len(pending) < 40)
    check(n + "held_provider_continuous", every([r for r in rows if phases["menu_hold"]+100 <= r["time"] < phases["released_arrival"]], lambda r: r["devices"][1]["connected"] and r["devices"][1]["buttons"] & 0x8200 == 0x8200))
    absent = [r for r in rows if not r["runtime"]["actors"][1]["observed"]]
    check(n + "actor_unload_observed", len(absent) > 5)
    unassigned = [r for r in rows if r["runtime"]["session"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["generation"] > d["initial"]["generation"]]
    check(n + "assignments_revoked", every(unassigned, lambda r: r["runtime"]["p1"] == r["runtime"]["p2"] == -1))
    # Runtime, renderer and HUD diagnostics are sampled separately. Require
    # restored presentation after 300ms of uninterrupted suspension.
    stable_menu, since = [], None
    for r in rows:
        if r["runtime"]["session"] == 3:
            since = r["time"] if since is None else since
            if r["time"]-since >= 300:
                stable_menu.append(r)
        else:
            since = None
    check(n + "suspension_hides_P2", every(stable_menu, lambda r: not r["split"]["active"] and not r["hud"]["visible"] and not r["skills"]["visible"]))
    held = [r for r in rows if phases["held_rejoined"]+1000 <= r["time"] < phases["released_arrival"]]
    check(n + "rejoined_new_generation", every(held, lambda r: r["runtime"]["session"] == 2 and r["runtime"]["stage"] == 100 and r["runtime"]["p1"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["p2"] == 1 and r["runtime"]["generation"] > d["initial"]["generation"]))
    check(n + "held_skill_blocked_without_action_or_cost", len(held) > 40 and every(held, lambda r: r["runtime"]["actors"][1]["action"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["actors"][1]["held"] == 0x800004 and r["hud"]["stamina"] == 835 and r["skills"]["blocked"] == 2))
    check(n + "owned_palette_recovers", every(held, lambda r: r["skills"]["visible"] == 1 and r["skills"]["ids"] == expected[1][:3] and r["equipped"] == expected))
    check(n + "split_tracks_loaded_pawn", every(held, lambda r: r["split"]["active"] and r["hud"]["visible"] and math.dist(r["split"]["target"], [r["runtime"]["actors"][1]["pos"][i]+(140 if i == 1 else 0) for i in range(3)]) < .1))
    fresh = [r for r in rows if r["time"] >= phases["fresh_skill"]]
    check(n + "fresh_skill_after_release", any(r["runtime"]["actors"][1]["action"] == 0x105002a for r in fresh) and min(r["hud"]["stamina"] for r in fresh) < 800)
    check(n + "P1_independent_after_arrival", every([r for r in rows if r["time"] >= phases["held_rejoined"]+1000], lambda r: r["runtime"]["actors"][0]["action"] == 0 and r["runtime"]["actors"][0]["held"] == 0))
    tail = rows[-10:]
    check(n + "neutral_idle_end", every(tail, lambda r: all(a["action"] == a["held"] == 0 for a in r["runtime"]["actors"]) and all(p.get("buttons", 0) == 0 for p in r["devices"])))
    check(n + "updates_resume", bool(held) and held[-1]["runtime"]["actors"][1]["frames"] > held[0]["runtime"]["actors"][1]["frames"]+60)
    stages = set(r["runtime"]["stage"] for r in rows)
    check(n + "required_route", (220 in stages and 100 in stages) if mode == "travel" else (d["initial"]["stage"] == 100 and rows[-1]["runtime"]["stage"] == 100))
    measurements[mode] = dict(samples=len(rows), held_samples=len(held), actor_absent_samples=len(absent), stable_suspended_samples=len(stable_menu), native_pending_samples=len(pending), generations=sorted({r["runtime"]["generation"] for r in rows}), fresh_min_stamina=min(r["hud"]["stamina"] for r in fresh))

check("runtime_unchanged", sha(ROOT.parent / "ddcoop_runtime.dll") == "c3c1aa0637bed24e5bddc0555e985e56443b7584eb305a5f8f2ce920b13cefc1")
for name in ("shared-travel-held-arrival.png", "shared-reload-held-arrival.png", "shared-travel-initial-menu-refusal.json", "shared-reload-deadline.json", "shared-reload-retry-health-failure.json", "shared-lifecycle-five-minute.js", "shared-strider-fixture-switch.json"):
    artifact = ROOT / "private/research" / name
    evidence[str(artifact.relative_to(ROOT))] = sha(artifact)
report = dict(passed=sum(checks.values()), total=len(checks), checks=checks, evidence=evidence, measurements=measurements, sources={p: sha(ROOT/p) for p in ("research/shared_lifecycle_trial.js", "scripts/check_shared_lifecycle.py")}, runtime_sha256=sha(ROOT.parent/"ddcoop_runtime.dll"), scope="Current compiled Strider loadout baseline, one held-RB+Y Ferrystone trip and one native save/title/load cycle", input="Two synthetic XInput provider slots; one physical slot present", visual_review="AI reviewed native held-arrival capture: both views and release-held-skill prompt", limits=["Not S4 transition/save-load/soak counts", "No new death/revival or large-enemy coverage", "Other vocations, physical two-controller acceptance and final release remain open"])
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
report["unresolved"] = "An earlier title cycle sampled nativeOffline=0 with transport=2, no actors or assignments, then the harness stopped. Native readiness later returned. Detailed repeat did not reproduce it; cause remains open. The accepted traces require continuous readiness."
report["capture_versions"] = "Travel used preserved shared-lifecycle-five-minute.js. Accepted reload used current shared_lifecycle_trial.js with a 600s ceiling and read-only native offline detail. Earlier initial guard refusal, deadline and readiness interruption are retained."
report["visual_review"] = "AI reviewed both native arrival captures: both views, pawn skill names and release-held-skill prompt."
parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
with args.out.open("x") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=report["passed"], total=report["total"], failed=[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v])))
assert all(checks.values())

scripts/collect_process_cpu.py.text:
"""Collect bounded, read-only whole-process CPU-time samples as JSONL.

CPU percentages use one logical CPU as 100 and may exceed 100. They include
all process threads and are not mod-only CPU cost. Wall timestamps are midpoint
estimates around GetProcessTimes; raw QPC brackets and 100 ns counters are kept.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

MIN_SECONDS = 0.1
MAX_DURATION_SECONDS = 3600.0
MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60.0
FILETIME_EPOCH = 116444736000000000
FILETIME_TICKS_PER_SECOND = 10_000_000
PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION = 0x1000
SYNCHRONIZE = 0x00100000
WAIT_OBJECT_0 = 0
WAIT_TIMEOUT = 258
WAIT_FAILED = 0xFFFFFFFF


class CollectionError(RuntimeError):
    """The selected process could not be sampled safely or consistently."""


class FileTime(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwLowDateTime', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwHighDateTime', wintypes.DWORD)]


def _filetime_value(value: FileTime) -> int:
    return (int(value.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | int(value.dwLowDateTime)


def _utc_from_unix_ns(value: int) -> str:
    seconds, nanos = divmod(value, 1_000_000_000)
    stamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds, timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=nanos // 1000)
    return stamp.isoformat(timespec='microseconds').replace('+00:00', 'Z')


class WindowsProcessApi:
    """Minimal read-only Win32 process queries. Instantiate only on Windows."""

    def __init__(self):
        if os.name != 'nt':
            raise CollectionError('This collector requires Windows.')
        self.kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
        self.kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
        self.kernel32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(FileTime), ctypes.POINTER(FileTime),
            ctypes.POINTER(FileTime), ctypes.POINTER(FileTime),
        ]
        self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        self.kernel32.WaitForSingleObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.DWORD]
        self.kernel32.WaitForSingleObject.restype = wintypes.DWORD
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle.restype = wintypes.BOOL

    def open(self, pid: int):
        # Query-limited plus synchronization grants no process write/control rights.
        access = PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION | SYNCHRONIZE
        handle = self.kernel32.OpenProcess(access, False, pid)
        if not handle:
            error = ctypes.get_last_error()
            raise CollectionError(f'OpenProcess({pid}) failed with Windows error {error}.')
        return handle

    def wait(self, handle) -> int:
        return int(self.kernel32.WaitForSingleObject(handle, 0))

    def times(self, handle) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
        created, exited, kernel, user = FileTime(), FileTime(), FileTime(), FileTime()
        if not self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes(handle, ctypes.byref(created), ctypes.byref(exited),
                                             ctypes.byref(kernel), ctypes.byref(user)):
            error = ctypes.get_last_error()
            raise CollectionError(f'GetProcessTimes failed with Windows error {error}.')
        return (_filetime_value(created), _filetime_value(exited),
                _filetime_value(kernel), _filetime_value(user))

    def close(self, handle) -> None:
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle(handle)


def _check_wait(api, handle) -> None:
    result = api.wait(handle)
    if result == WAIT_OBJECT_0:
        raise CollectionError('The target process exited during collection.')
    if result == WAIT_FAILED:
        raise CollectionError('WaitForSingleObject failed while checking process lifetime.')
    if result != WAIT_TIMEOUT:
        raise CollectionError(f'Unexpected process wait result: {result}.')


def _checked_times(api, handle, expected_creation_filetime: int | None = None):
    _check_wait(api, handle)
    created, exited, kernel, user = api.times(handle)
    _check_wait(api, handle)
    if exited:
        raise CollectionError('The target process exited during collection.')
    if expected_creation_filetime is not None and created != expected_creation_filetime:
        raise CollectionError('The target PID now reports a different process creation time.')
    return created, kernel, user


def sample_process(api, handle, pid: int, expected_creation_filetime: int,
                   *, perf_counter_ns=time.perf_counter_ns, wall_time_ns=time.time_ns) -> dict:
    """Read CPU counters with monotonic brackets and estimated midpoint UTC."""
    _check_wait(api, handle)
    wall_before = wall_time_ns()
    perf_before = perf_counter_ns()
    created, exited, kernel, user = api.times(handle)
    perf_after = perf_counter_ns()
    wall_after = wall_time_ns()
    _check_wait(api, handle)
    if exited:
        raise CollectionError('The target process exited during collection.')
    if created != expected_creation_filetime:
        raise CollectionError('The target PID now reports a different process creation time.')
    if perf_after < perf_before:
        raise CollectionError('The monotonic performance counter moved backwards.')
    if wall_after < wall_before:
        raise CollectionError('The wall clock moved backwards during a sample.')
    perf_midpoint = perf_before + (perf_after - perf_before) // 2
    wall_midpoint = wall_before + (wall_after - wall_before) // 2
    return {
        'schema_version': 1,
        'kind': 'process_cpu_sample',
        'counter_source': 'GetProcessTimes',
        'time_unit': '100ns',
        'pid': pid,
        'process_creation_filetime': created,
        'perf_counter_start_ns': perf_before,
        'perf_counter_end_ns': perf_after,
        'perf_counter_midpoint_ns': perf_midpoint,
        'wall_midpoint_unix_ns_estimate': wall_midpoint,
        'wall_utc_midpoint_estimate': _utc_from_unix_ns(wall_midpoint),
        'kernel_time_100ns': kernel,
        'user_time_100ns': user,
        'process_cpu_time_100ns': kernel + user,
        'cpu_delta_kernel_100ns': None,
        'cpu_delta_user_100ns': None,
        'cpu_delta_total_100ns': None,
        'cpu_interval_wall_ns': None,
        'cpu_percent_one_core': None,
    }


def _add_deltas(record: dict, previous: dict | None) -> None:
    if previous is None:
        return
    wall_delta = record['perf_counter_midpoint_ns'] - previous['perf_counter_midpoint_ns']
    kernel_delta = record['kernel_time_100ns'] - previous['kernel_time_100ns']
    user_delta = record['user_time_100ns'] - previous['user_time_100ns']
    if wall_delta <= 0:
        raise CollectionError('The monotonic performance counter did not advance between samples.')
    if kernel_delta < 0 or user_delta < 0:
        raise CollectionError('Process CPU time counter moved backwards.')
    total_delta = kernel_delta + user_delta
    record['cpu_delta_kernel_100ns'] = kernel_delta
    record['cpu_delta_user_100ns'] = user_delta
    record['cpu_delta_total_100ns'] = total_delta
    record['cpu_interval_wall_ns'] = wall_delta
    # One 100 ns CPU tick equals 100 ns; percentage is CPU ticks / wall ticks * 100.
    record['cpu_percent_one_core'] = total_delta * 10_000.0 / wall_delta


def _write_jsonl(stream, record: dict) -> None:
    stream.write(json.dumps(record, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n')
    stream.flush()
    os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def collect(pid: int, duration_seconds: float, interval_seconds: float, output: Path,
            *, expected_creation_filetime: int | None = None, api=None,
            perf_counter_ns=time.perf_counter_ns, wall_time_ns=time.time_ns, sleeper=time.sleep) -> int:
    validate_bounds(pid, duration_seconds, interval_seconds, expected_creation_filetime)
    api = api or WindowsProcessApi()
    handle = api.open(pid)
    try:
        creation, _, _ = _checked_times(api, handle, expected_creation_filetime)
        started_perf = perf_counter_ns()
        deadline = started_perf + int(duration_seconds * 1_000_000_000)
        count = 0
        previous = None
        with Path(output).open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
            header_wall = wall_time_ns()
            _write_jsonl(stream, {
                'schema_version': 1,
                'kind': 'process_cpu_header',
                'pid': pid,
                'process_creation_filetime': creation,
                'expected_creation_filetime': expected_creation_filetime,
                'collection_started_wall_utc': _utc_from_unix_ns(header_wall),
                'duration_seconds': duration_seconds,
                'interval_seconds': interval_seconds,
                'cpu_counter_unit': '100ns',
                'wall_timestamp': 'UTC midpoint estimate around GetProcessTimes; raw perf_counter_ns bracket is retained',
                'cpu_percentage_basis': 'one logical CPU equals 100 percent; process-wide and may exceed 100; not mod-only CPU',
                'access_rights': 'PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE; read-only',
            })
            while True:
                before_sample = perf_counter_ns()
                if count and before_sample > deadline:
                    break
                record = sample_process(api, handle, pid, creation,
                                        perf_counter_ns=perf_counter_ns, wall_time_ns=wall_time_ns)
                if record['perf_counter_midpoint_ns'] < started_perf:
                    raise CollectionError('Sample midpoint precedes the collection start counter.')
                if record['perf_counter_midpoint_ns'] > deadline:
                    break
                record['elapsed_midpoint_ns'] = record['perf_counter_midpoint_ns'] - started_perf
                _add_deltas(record, previous)
                _write_jsonl(stream, record)
                count += 1
                previous = record
                remaining_ns = deadline - perf_counter_ns()
                if remaining_ns <= 0:
                    break
                sleeper(min(interval_seconds, remaining_ns / 1_000_000_000))
        return count
    finally:
        api.close(handle)


def _finite_seconds(value: float, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a finite number of seconds.')
    return float(value)


def validate_bounds(pid: int, duration_seconds: float, interval_seconds: float,
                    expected_creation_filetime: int | None = None) -> None:
    if type(pid) is not int or not 1 <= pid <= 0xFFFFFFFF:
        raise ValueError('PID must be a positive Windows process ID.')
    duration = _finite_seconds(duration_seconds, 'Duration')
    interval = _finite_seconds(interval_seconds, 'Interval')
    if not MIN_SECONDS <= duration <= MAX_DURATION_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError(f'Duration must be between {MIN_SECONDS:g} and {MAX_DURATION_SECONDS:g} seconds.')
    if not MIN_SECONDS <= interval <= MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError(f'Interval must be between {MIN_SECONDS:g} and {MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS:g} seconds.')
    if interval > duration:
        raise ValueError('Interval cannot exceed duration.')
    if expected_creation_filetime is not None and (
            type(expected_creation_filetime) is not int or not 0 < expected_creation_filetime <= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF):
        raise ValueError('Expected creation FILETIME must be a positive uint64 value.')


def _positive_seconds(value: str) -> float:
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be a number of seconds') from exc
    if not math.isfinite(number) or number <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be finite and positive')
    return number


def _positive_integer(value: str) -> int:
    try:
        number = int(value, 10)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be an integer') from exc
    if number <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be positive')
    return number


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--pid', type=_positive_integer, required=True, help='explicit Windows process ID')
    parser.add_argument('--duration-seconds', type=_positive_seconds, required=True,
                        help=f'bounded duration, {MIN_SECONDS:g}..{MAX_DURATION_SECONDS:g}')
    parser.add_argument('--interval-seconds', type=_positive_seconds, default=10.0,
                        help=f'sample interval, {MIN_SECONDS:g}..{MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS:g} (default: 10)')
    parser.add_argument('--expected-creation-filetime', type=_positive_integer,
                        help='optional expected process creation FILETIME to bind the PID')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True, help='new JSONL file; existing paths are refused')
    return parser


def main(argv=None, *, api=None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        count = collect(args.pid, args.duration_seconds, args.interval_seconds, args.output,
                        expected_creation_filetime=args.expected_creation_filetime, api=api)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print('collection interrupted; flushed JSONL header and samples are retained.', file=sys.stderr)
        return 130
    except (CollectionError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f'process CPU collection failed: {exc}', file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f'Wrote {count} flushed samples to {args.output}')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Collect bounded, read-only Windows process memory samples as JSONL.

`pagefile_usage_bytes` is the Win32 process commit-charge counter, not disk I/O.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

MAX_DURATION_SECONDS = 3 * 60 * 60
MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60 * 60
FILETIME_EPOCH = 116444736000000000
FILETIME_TICKS_PER_SECOND = 10_000_000
PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION = 0x0400
PROCESS_VM_READ = 0x0010


class CollectionError(RuntimeError):
    """A process could not be sampled safely or consistently."""


class FileTime(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwLowDateTime', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwHighDateTime', wintypes.DWORD)]


class ProcessMemoryCountersEx(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('cb', wintypes.DWORD),
        ('PageFaultCount', wintypes.DWORD),
        ('PeakWorkingSetSize', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('WorkingSetSize', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('QuotaPeakPagedPoolUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('QuotaPagedPoolUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('QuotaPeakNonPagedPoolUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('QuotaNonPagedPoolUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('PagefileUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('PeakPagefileUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('PrivateUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
    ]


def _filetime_value(value: FileTime) -> int:
    return (int(value.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | int(value.dwLowDateTime)


def _filetime_utc(value: int) -> str:
    seconds = (value - FILETIME_EPOCH) / FILETIME_TICKS_PER_SECOND
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds, timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00', 'Z')


class WindowsProcessApi:
    """Minimal read-only Win32 process queries. Instantiate only on Windows."""

    def __init__(self):
        if os.name != 'nt':
            raise CollectionError('This collector requires Windows.')
        self.kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
        self.psapi = ctypes.WinDLL('psapi', use_last_error=True)
        self.kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
        self.kernel32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(FileTime), ctypes.POINTER(FileTime),
            ctypes.POINTER(FileTime), ctypes.POINTER(FileTime),
        ]
        self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        self.psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(ProcessMemoryCountersEx), wintypes.DWORD,
        ]
        self.psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo.restype = wintypes.BOOL

    def open(self, pid: int):
        # PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION and PROCESS_VM_READ grant no write/control rights.
        access = PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ
        handle = self.kernel32.OpenProcess(access, False, pid)
        if not handle:
            error = ctypes.get_last_error()
            raise CollectionError(f'OpenProcess({pid}) failed with Windows error {error}.')
        return handle

    def times(self, handle) -> tuple[int, int]:
        created, exited, kernel, user = FileTime(), FileTime(), FileTime(), FileTime()
        if not self.kernel32.GetProcessTimes(handle, ctypes.byref(created), ctypes.byref(exited),
                                             ctypes.byref(kernel), ctypes.byref(user)):
            error = ctypes.get_last_error()
            raise CollectionError(f'GetProcessTimes failed with Windows error {error}.')
        return _filetime_value(created), _filetime_value(exited)

    def memory(self, handle) -> dict[str, int]:
        counters = ProcessMemoryCountersEx()
        counters.cb = ctypes.sizeof(counters)
        if not self.psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo(handle, ctypes.byref(counters), counters.cb):
            error = ctypes.get_last_error()
            raise CollectionError(f'GetProcessMemoryInfo failed with Windows error {error}.')
        return {
            'page_fault_count': int(counters.PageFaultCount),
            'working_set_bytes': int(counters.WorkingSetSize),
            'peak_working_set_bytes': int(counters.PeakWorkingSetSize),
            'pagefile_usage_bytes': int(counters.PagefileUsage),
            'peak_pagefile_usage_bytes': int(counters.PeakPagefileUsage),
            'private_usage_bytes': int(counters.PrivateUsage),
        }

    def close(self, handle) -> None:
        self.kernel32.CloseHandle(handle)


def _live_creation_time(api, handle, expected: int | None = None) -> int:
    created, exited = api.times(handle)
    if exited:
        raise CollectionError('The target process exited during collection.')
    if expected is not None and created != expected:
        raise CollectionError('The target PID now reports a different process creation time.')
    return created


def sample_record(api, handle, pid: int, expected_creation: int,
                  elapsed_seconds: float, wall_utc: str) -> dict:
    _live_creation_time(api, handle, expected_creation)
    memory = api.memory(handle)
    _live_creation_time(api, handle, expected_creation)
    return {
        'schema_version': 1,
        'kind': 'process_memory_sample',
        'counter_source': 'PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX',
        'wall_utc': wall_utc,
        'elapsed_seconds': round(max(0.0, elapsed_seconds), 3),
        'pid': pid,
        'process_creation_filetime': expected_creation,
        'process_creation_utc': _filetime_utc(expected_creation),
        **memory,
    }


def collect(pid: int, duration_seconds: int, interval_seconds: int, output: Path,
            *, api=None, monotonic=time.monotonic, sleeper=time.sleep, utc_now=None) -> int:
    """Collect an initial sample followed by bounded periodic samples; dependencies are injectable."""
    validate_bounds(pid, duration_seconds, interval_seconds)
    api = api or WindowsProcessApi()
    utc_now = utc_now or (lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00', 'Z'))
    handle = api.open(pid)
    try:
        creation = _live_creation_time(api, handle)
        started = monotonic()
        count = 0
        # Exclusive creation prevents accidental replacement of previous evidence.
        with Path(output).open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
            deadline = started + duration_seconds
            while True:
                now = monotonic()
                if count and now > deadline:
                    break
                record = sample_record(api, handle, pid, creation, now - started, utc_now())
                stream.write(json.dumps(record, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n')
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                count += 1
                remaining = deadline - monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                sleeper(min(interval_seconds, remaining))
        return count
    finally:
        api.close(handle)


def validate_bounds(pid: int, duration_seconds: int, interval_seconds: int) -> None:
    if type(pid) is not int or not 1 <= pid <= 0xFFFFFFFF:
        raise ValueError('PID must be a positive Windows process ID.')
    if type(duration_seconds) is not int or not 1 <= duration_seconds <= MAX_DURATION_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError(f'Duration must be between 1 and {MAX_DURATION_SECONDS} seconds.')
    if type(interval_seconds) is not int or not 1 <= interval_seconds <= MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError(f'Interval must be between 1 and {MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS} seconds.')
    if interval_seconds > duration_seconds:
        raise ValueError('Interval cannot exceed duration.')


def _positive_integer(value: str) -> int:
    try:
        number = int(value, 10)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be an integer') from exc
    if number <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('must be positive')
    return number


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Collect read-only Windows process memory samples to JSONL.')
    parser.add_argument('--pid', type=_positive_integer, required=True, help='explicit Windows process ID')
    parser.add_argument('--duration-seconds', type=_positive_integer, required=True,
                        help=f'collection duration, 1..{MAX_DURATION_SECONDS}')
    parser.add_argument('--interval-seconds', type=_positive_integer, default=60,
                        help=f'sample interval, 1..{MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS} (default: 60)')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True, help='new JSONL file; existing paths are refused')
    return parser


def main(argv=None, *, api=None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        validate_bounds(args.pid, args.duration_seconds, args.interval_seconds)
        count = collect(args.pid, args.duration_seconds, args.interval_seconds, args.output, api=api)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print('collection interrupted; already flushed JSONL samples are retained.', file=sys.stderr)
        return 130
    except (CollectionError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f'process memory collection failed: {exc}', file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f'Wrote {count} flushed samples to {args.output}')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def main():
    data = (ROOT.parent / 'DDDA.exe').read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != EXPECTED:
        raise SystemExit('Unsupported executable; manifest not generated')
    pe = pefile.PE(data=data)
    sections = [s for s in pe.sections if s.Characteristics & 0x20000000]
    lines = ['// Exact build 2364871; generated by scripts/generate_runtime_manifest.py.',
             '#pragma once', '#include <cstdint>', '#include <array>',
             'namespace coop::build {',
             f'inline constexpr char sha256[] = "{EXPECTED}";',
             '// EXP-001 import callers; exact six-byte game JMP [IAT] thunks. Detour the',
             "// game's entry boundary, leaving controller translation at DLL exports intact.",
             'struct InputThunk { const char* name; std::uintptr_t rva; std::array<unsigned char,6> bytes; };',
             f'inline constexpr std::array<InputThunk,{len(INPUT_THUNKS)}> input_thunks{{{{']
    for name, (va, expected) in INPUT_THUNKS.items():
        rva = va - pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
        sig = pe.get_data(rva, len(expected))
        count = sum(s.get_data().count(sig) for s in sections)
        if sig != expected or count != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'{name}: unexpected thunk {sig.hex()}, signature count {count}')
        encoded = ','.join(f'0x{x:02x}' for x in sig)
        lines.append(f'    {{"{name}",0x{rva:x},{{{encoded}}}}},')
    lines += ['}};',
              'struct Symbol { const char* name; std::uintptr_t rva; std::array<unsigned char,32> bytes; };',
              f'inline constexpr std::array<Symbol,{len(POINTS)}> symbols = {{{{']
    for name, va in POINTS.items():
        rva = va - pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
        sig = pe.get_data(rva, 32)
        count = sum(s.get_data().count(sig) for s in sections)
        # The close entry has a shared prefix; its exact fixed RVA is checked
        # together with the adjacent unique body and full supported EXE hash.
        expected_count = 2 if name == 'dialogue_close_entry' else 1
        if count != expected_count: raise SystemExit(f'{name}: signature count {count}')
        encoded = ','.join(f'0x{x:02x}' for x in sig)
        lines.append(f'    {{"{name}", 0x{rva:x}, {{{encoded}}}}},')
    lines += ['}};', '}']
    (ROOT / 'include/coop/supported_build.hpp').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Generated {len(POINTS)} fixed-RVA 32-byte signatures and {len(INPUT_THUNKS)} six-byte input thunks for {EXPECTED}')

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import pefile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
game = root.parent
exe = game / "DDDA.exe"
pe = pefile.PE(str(exe))
manifest = game.parents[1] / "appmanifest_367500.acf"
text = manifest.read_text() if manifest.exists() else ""
match = re.search(r'"buildid"\s+"(\d+)"', text)
result = {
    "filename": exe.name,
    "sha256": hashlib.file_digest(exe.open("rb"), "sha256").hexdigest(),
    "size_bytes": exe.stat().st_size,
    "machine": hex(pe.FILE_HEADER.Machine),
    "architecture": "x86" if pe.FILE_HEADER.Machine == 0x14C else "other",
    "preferred_image_base": hex(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase),
    "entry_point_rva": hex(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint),
    "timestamp": pe.FILE_HEADER.TimeDateStamp,
    "large_address_aware": bool(pe.FILE_HEADER.Characteristics & 0x20),
    "steam_appid": 367500,

    "imports": {d.dll.decode(): [i.name.decode() if i.name else f"ordinal:{i.ordinal}" for i in d.imports] for d in getattr(pe, "DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT", [])},
    "sections": [{"name": s.Name.rstrip(b"\0").decode(), "rva": hex(s.VirtualAddress), "virtual_size": s.Misc_VirtualSize} for s in pe.sections],
    "root_proxy_files": [p.name for p in game.glob("*.dll") if p.name.lower() != "steam_api.dll"],

}

(out / "game-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ("sha256", "architecture", "steam_buildid", "large_address_aware", "root_proxy_files")}, indent=2))
print("Imported input/render libraries:", [n for n in result["imports"] if any(s in n.lower() for s in ("input", "d3d"))])

"""Find instructions using one constant displacement; static leads, not proof."""
import sys, re, struct
from pathlib import Path
import pefile
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32
pe=pefile.PE(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'DDDA.exe'))
value=int(sys.argv[1],0)
cs=Cs(CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_32)
for sec in pe.sections:
 if not sec.Characteristics & 0x20000000: continue
 b=sec.get_data();base=pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase+sec.VirtualAddress
 for m in re.finditer(re.escape(struct.pack('<I',value)),b):
  for before in [2,3,4]:
   start=m.start()-before
   ins=next(cs.disasm(b[start:start+15],base+start),None)
   if ins and re.search(r'0x'+format(value,'x')+r'\b', ins.op_str) and '[' in ins.op_str:
    if '--writes' in sys.argv and (not ins.mnemonic.startswith(('mov','and','or','xor','inc','dec')) or not ins.op_str.split(',')[0].endswith(']')): continue
    print(f'{ins.address:08x} {ins.bytes.hex():24s} {ins.mnemonic} {ins.op_str}')
    break

from pathlib import Path
import argparse, json, time, uuid
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ipc = root / "private/research/session"
p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--file", type=Path)
p.add_argument("--status", action="store_true")
p.add_argument("--out", type=Path)
args = p.parse_args()
if not args.status and args.file is None: p.error("--file or --status required")
request = {"id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "action": "status" if args.status else "evaluate", "source": args.file.read_text() if args.file else ""}
tmp = ipc / "command.tmp"
tmp.write_text(json.dumps(request))
publish_deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
while True:
    try:
        tmp.replace(ipc / "command.json")
        break
    except PermissionError:
        if time.monotonic() >= publish_deadline: raise
        time.sleep(.05)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 25
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    result_path = ipc / "result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        try:
            result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
        except (PermissionError, FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            time.sleep(0.1)
            continue
        if result["id"] == request["id"]:
            text = json.dumps(result, indent=2)
            if args.out: args.out.write_text(text)
            print(text)
            raise SystemExit(0 if result["ok"] else 1)
    time.sleep(0.1)
raise SystemExit("Research command timed out; inspect host/game status before retrying")

scripts/stage_dinput_drop_in.py.text:
"""Stage the pinned, launcher-free 1.6.0 DirectInput drop-in package.

This entry point shares the XInput release's reviewed runtime, settings and PE
inspection helpers. It accepts only the exact DInput proxy export contract and
a public acceptance record pinned to that loader and runtime. It never examines
or modifies an installed game.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import stage_player_installer as installer
import stage_xinput_drop_in as shared

VERSION = '1.6.0'
OUTPUT_NAMES = ('dinput8.dll', 'ddcoop_runtime.dll', 'ddcoop.ini', 'README.txt')
DINPUT_EXPORTS = {
    1: 'DirectInput8Create', 2: 'DllCanUnloadNow',
    3: 'DllGetClassObject', 4: 'DllRegisterServer',
    5: 'DllUnregisterServer', 6: 'GetdfDIJoystick',
}
RUNTIME_BUILD_ID = shared.RUNTIME_BUILD_ID
RELEASE_1_6_DINPUT_GUIDE_SHA256 = 'a65ff33a6c8e4e3f6d1a8d02fc1f16708c2e7f67f8cb73960011f0c260212c68'


def _sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _guide(raw):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n', '\n')
    if not text.splitlines() or 'version 1.6.0 ' not in text.splitlines()[0]:
        raise ValueError('README version disagrees with selected DInput release')
    if 'dinput8.dll' not in text.lower():
        raise ValueError('DInput guide must identify dinput8.dll')
    titles = list(shared.APPENDICES)
    for index, title in enumerate(titles):
        marker = '\n' + title + '\n'
        if text.count(marker) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f'README requires complete {title}')
        start = text.index(marker) + len(marker)
        stop = text.index('\n' + titles[index + 1] + '\n') if index + 1 < len(titles) else len(text)
        if stop < start or _sha(text[start:stop].strip().encode('utf-8')) != shared.APPENDICES[title]:
            raise ValueError(f'README complete {title} hash mismatch')
    if any(name.lower() in text.lower() for name in ('Install.cmd', 'Uninstall.cmd', 'Manage-Coop.ps1')):
        raise ValueError('README must not include installer instructions')
    if _sha(text.encode('utf-8')) != RELEASE_1_6_DINPUT_GUIDE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed 1.6.0 DInput player guide')


def _acceptance(path, pin, payloads):
    if path is None or pin is None:
        raise ValueError('DInput public release requires a pinned acceptance record')
    raw = shared._read_pin(path, pin, 'Acceptance record')
    record = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), object_pairs_hook=shared._object)
    if not isinstance(record, dict) or type(record.get('schema')) is not int or record['schema'] != 1:
        raise ValueError('Acceptance record must use schema 1')
    expected = dict(
        status='passed', game_sha256=installer.GAME_SHA,
        loader=dict(kind='dinput8', name='dinput8.dll', sha256=_sha(payloads['dinput8.dll']), version=VERSION),
        runtime_sha256=_sha(payloads['ddcoop_runtime.dll']), runtime_version=VERSION,
        runtime_build_id=RUNTIME_BUILD_ID, public_redistribution=True,
        supported_p2_vocations=list(installer.SUPPORTED_P2_VOCATIONS),
    )
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if record.get(key) != value or (key == 'public_redistribution' and type(record.get(key)) is not bool):
            raise ValueError(f'Acceptance {key} mismatch')
    if record.get('launcher_omitted') is not True or 'launcher_sha256' in record:
        raise ValueError('Launcher-free release requires explicit acceptance without a launcher pin')
    physical = record.get('physical_controller_acceptance')
    if (not isinstance(physical, dict) or physical.get('status') not in ('unverified', 'partial', 'passed') or
            not isinstance(physical.get('disclosure'), str) or not physical['disclosure'].strip()):
        raise ValueError('Acceptance requires physical-controller status and disclosure')
    profile = record.get('compatibility_profile')
    if not isinstance(profile, str) or not profile.strip():
        raise ValueError('Acceptance requires explicit tested compatibility_profile')
    return dict(record_sha256=_sha(raw), **expected, compatibility_profile=profile.strip(),
                physical_controller_acceptance=physical)


def stage(loader, runtime, settings, guide, out, zip_out, receipt_out, *,
          loader_sha256, runtime_sha256, settings_sha256, guide_sha256,
          acceptance_record, acceptance_sha256):
    out = Path(out)
    zip_destination = installer._validate_zip_destination(out, Path(zip_out))
    receipt = Path(receipt_out).resolve()
    if receipt == out.resolve() or out.resolve() in receipt.parents or receipt == zip_destination:
        raise ValueError('Private receipt must be outside the stage and ZIP')
    if receipt.suffix.lower() != '.json' or not receipt.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Private receipt needs a .json path with existing parent')
    if receipt.exists() or out.exists():
        raise FileExistsError('Refusing to overwrite staging directory or private receipt')
    if not out.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Staging parent directory must already exist')
    paths = (loader, runtime, settings, guide)
    pins = (loader_sha256, runtime_sha256, settings_sha256, guide_sha256)
    payloads = {name: shared._read_pin(path, pin, name) for name, path, pin in zip(OUTPUT_NAMES, paths, pins)}
    if shared._pe_exports(payloads['dinput8.dll'], 'Loader') != DINPUT_EXPORTS:
        raise ValueError('DInput loader exports differ from reviewed exact name/ordinal contract')
    runtime_exports = shared._pe_exports(payloads['ddcoop_runtime.dll'], 'Runtime')
    if not {'CoopInitialize', 'CoopRuntimeBuildIdentity'} <= set(runtime_exports.values()):
        raise ValueError('Runtime requires CoopInitialize and CoopRuntimeBuildIdentity exports')
    shared._player_settings(payloads['ddcoop.ini'], VERSION)
    _guide(payloads['README.txt'])
    acceptance = _acceptance(acceptance_record, acceptance_sha256, payloads)
    hashes = {name: _sha(data) for name, data in payloads.items()}
    verification = dict(
        schema=1, version=VERSION, package_kind='dinput8-drop-in',
        distribution_status=installer.PUBLIC_STATUS, public_release=True,
        release_candidate=False, game_sha256=installer.GAME_SHA,
        loader=dict(kind='dinput8', name='dinput8.dll', sha256=hashes['dinput8.dll'], version=VERSION),
        runtime_version=VERSION, runtime_build_id=RUNTIME_BUILD_ID,
        payload_sha256=hashes,
        pe_inspection='x86 PE32 exports only; runtime build identity is verified by native acceptance',
        source_paths={name: str(Path(path).resolve()) for name, path in zip(OUTPUT_NAMES, paths)},
        acceptance=acceptance,
    )
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for name, data in payloads.items():
        with (out / name).open('xb') as output:
            output.write(data)
        if (out / name).read_bytes() != data:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Staging copy mismatch: {name}')
    installer._write_archive(zip_destination, payloads)
    verification['archive_sha256'] = _sha(zip_destination.read_bytes())
    with receipt.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as output:
        output.write(json.dumps(verification, indent=2) + '\n')
    result = dict(staged=str(out.resolve()), zip=str(zip_destination), receipt=str(receipt),
                  files=list(OUTPUT_NAMES), verification=verification)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('loader', 'runtime', 'settings', 'guide', 'out'):
        parser.add_argument(name, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--zip-out', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--receipt-out', required=True, type=Path)
    for name in ('loader', 'runtime', 'settings', 'guide'):
        parser.add_argument(f'--{name}-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--acceptance-record', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--acceptance-sha256', required=True)
    stage(**vars(parser.parse_args()))

def _sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _read_pin(path, expected, label):
    if not isinstance(expected, str) or not installer.SHA_PATTERN.fullmatch(expected):
        raise ValueError(f'{label} SHA-256 must be 64 hexadecimal characters')
    path = Path(path)
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f'{label} source must be a regular file')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if _sha(raw) != expected.lower():
        raise ValueError(f'{label} SHA-256 mismatch')
    return raw


def _pe_exports(raw, label):
    """Read bounded PE32 export tables, requiring local executable entry points."""
    def unpack(fmt, offset):
        size = struct.calcsize(fmt)
        if offset < 0 or offset + size > len(raw):
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: truncated PE')
        return struct.unpack_from(fmt, raw, offset)

    if raw[:2] != b'MZ':
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: not a PE DLL')
    pe, = unpack('<I', 0x3c)
    if raw[pe:pe + 4] != b'PE\0\0':
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: invalid PE signature')
    machine, count, _, _, _, opt_size, flags = unpack('<HHIIIHH', pe + 4)
    opt = pe + 24
    if (machine != 0x14c or not flags & 0x2000 or count < 1 or count > 96 or
            opt_size < 104 or unpack('<H', opt)[0] != 0x10b):
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: requires an x86 PE32 DLL')
    if unpack('<I', opt + 92)[0] < 1:
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: missing export directory')
    export_rva, export_size = unpack('<II', opt + 96)
    sections = []
    for index in range(count):
        item = opt + opt_size + 40 * index
        virtual_size, rva, size, offset = unpack('<IIII', item + 8)
        characteristics, = unpack('<I', item + 36)
        if offset + size > len(raw):
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: truncated PE section')
        sections.append((rva, virtual_size, size, offset, characteristics))

    def locate(rva, size=1, executable=False):
        matches = []
        for start, _, raw_size, offset, characteristics in sections:
            if start <= rva and rva + size <= start + raw_size:
                if not executable or characteristics & 0x20000000:
                    matches.append(offset + rva - start)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: invalid PE RVA or non-executable export')
        return matches[0]

    if not export_rva or export_size < 40:
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: missing export directory')
    directory = unpack('<IIHHIIIIIII', locate(export_rva, 40))
    base, function_count, name_count, functions, names, ordinals = directory[5:]
    if not 1 <= function_count <= 4096 or name_count > function_count:
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: invalid export count')
    entries = {}
    for index in range(function_count):
        address, = unpack('<I', locate(functions + 4 * index, 4))
        if address:
            if export_rva <= address < export_rva + export_size:
                raise ValueError(f'{label}: forwarded export is not a local proxy entry')
            locate(address, executable=True)
            entries[base + index] = None
    seen_names = set()
    for index in range(name_count):
        name_rva, = unpack('<I', locate(names + 4 * index, 4))
        ordinal_index, = unpack('<H', locate(ordinals + 2 * index, 2))
        ordinal = base + ordinal_index
        if ordinal not in entries or entries[ordinal] is not None:
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: invalid/aliased export ordinal')
        name_bytes = bytearray()
        for char_index in range(256):
            value = raw[locate(name_rva + char_index)]
            if value == 0:
                break
            name_bytes.append(value)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: unterminated export name')
        try:
            name = name_bytes.decode('ascii')
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: non-ASCII export name') from error
        if not name or name in seen_names:
            raise ValueError(f'{label}: duplicate/empty export name')
        seen_names.add(name)
        entries[ordinal] = name
    return entries


def _guide(raw, version):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n', '\n')
    if f'version {version} ' not in text.splitlines()[0]:
        raise ValueError('README version disagrees with selected release')
    if 'xinput1_3.dll' not in text or OLD_COOP_SHA not in text:
        raise ValueError('README requires XInput migration and positively identified old co-op SHA')
    titles = list(APPENDICES)
    for index, title in enumerate(titles):
        marker = '\n' + title + '\n'
        if text.count(marker) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f'README requires complete {title}')
        start = text.index(marker) + len(marker)
        stop = text.index('\n' + titles[index + 1] + '\n') if index + 1 < len(titles) else len(text)
        if stop < start or _sha(text[start:stop].strip().encode('utf-8')) != APPENDICES[title]:
            raise ValueError(f'README complete {title} hash mismatch')
    if any(name.lower() in text.lower() for name in ('Install.cmd', 'Uninstall.cmd', 'Manage-Coop.ps1')):
        raise ValueError('README must not include installer instructions')
    if version == SHARED_LIVES_CANDIDATE_VERSION and _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != SHARED_LIVES_GUIDE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed shared-lives candidate guide')
    if version == HEALTH_BARS_CANDIDATE_VERSION and _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != HEALTH_BARS_GUIDE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed health-bars candidate guide')
    if (version == SHARED_LIFE_FOLLOWUP_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != SHARED_LIFE_FOLLOWUP_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed shared-life follow-up candidate guide')
    if (version == HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed horizontal-split candidate guide')
    if (version == NPC_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != NPC_INTERACTION_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed P2 NPC-interaction candidate guide')
    if (version == CAMERA_FIGHTER_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != CAMERA_FIGHTER_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed rc8 player guide')
    if (version == ALL_VOCATION_THROW_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != ALL_VOCATION_THROW_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed rc9 player guide')
    if (version == DISTANCE_AUDIO_CANDIDATE_VERSION and
            _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != DISTANCE_AUDIO_GUIDE_SHA256):
        raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed rc10 player guide')
    if version == RELEASE_1_6_VERSION:
        if _sha(text.strip().encode('utf-8')) != RELEASE_1_6_GUIDE_SHA256:
            raise ValueError('README differs from the reviewed 1.6.0 player guide')


def _player_settings(raw, version):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
    if version == RELEASE_1_6_VERSION:
        # Keep historical validation for unrelated keys while validating the
        # 1.6.0 defaults added since the original installer allowlist.
        expected = {'p2_npc_interaction': '1', 'shared_lives': '0', 'shared_life_count': '3',
                    'p2_enemy_health_bars': '1', 'p2_ally_health_bars': '0'}
        sections = {'shared_lives': 'recovery', 'shared_life_count': 'recovery',
                    'p2_npc_interaction': 'coop', 'p2_enemy_health_bars': 'feedback',
                    'p2_ally_health_bars': 'feedback'}
        # A later candidate may carry the keyboard/mouse opt-in. Accept and
        # strictly validate it here without changing the pinned 1.6.0 guide
        # or requiring the key in historical 1.6.0 settings payloads.
        expected['p1_keyboard_mouse'] = '0'
        sections['p1_keyboard_mouse'] = 'input'
        optional = {'p1_keyboard_mouse'}
        seen = set()
        section = ''
        legacy = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            row = line.split(';', 1)[0].split('#', 1)[0].strip(' \t\r')
            if row.startswith('[') and row.endswith(']'):
                section = row[1:-1].strip(' \t\r').lower()
            key, separator, value = row.partition('=')
            key = key.strip(' \t\r').lower()
            if section == sections.get(key) and separator and key in expected:
                if key in seen or value.strip(' \t\r') != expected[key]:
                    raise ValueError(f'1.6.0 player settings require one default {section}.{key}={expected[key]}')
                seen.add(key)
                legacy.append('; 1.6.0 default validated separately')
            else:
                legacy.append(line)
        if seen - optional != set(expected) - optional:
            raise ValueError('1.6.0 player settings require all explicit release defaults')
        layouts = []
        section = ''
        for line in text.splitlines():
            row = line.split(';', 1)[0].split('#', 1)[0].strip(' \t\r')
            if row.startswith('[') and row.endswith(']'):
                section = row[1:-1].strip(' \t\r').lower()
            key, separator, value = row.partition('=')
            if section == 'camera' and separator and key.strip(' \t\r').lower() == 'split_layout':
                layouts.append(value.strip(' \t\r').lower())
        if layouts != ['vertical']:
            raise ValueError('1.6.0 player settings require one default camera.split_layout=vertical')
        installer._assert_player_settings('\n'.join(legacy))
        return
    if version not in (SHARED_LIVES_CANDIDATE_VERSION, HEALTH_BARS_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       SHARED_LIFE_FOLLOWUP_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       NPC_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_VERSION, CAMERA_FIGHTER_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       ALL_VOCATION_THROW_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       DISTANCE_AUDIO_CANDIDATE_VERSION):
        installer._assert_player_settings(text)
        return
    # The older installer validator deliberately retains its existing allowlist.
    # Validate candidate defaults here; every other line still passes through
    # that strict validator, including section/duplicate/dev/online rules.
    expected = {'shared_lives': '0', 'shared_life_count': '3'}
    if version in (HEALTH_BARS_CANDIDATE_VERSION, SHARED_LIFE_FOLLOWUP_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                   HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_CANDIDATE_VERSION, NPC_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                   CAMERA_FIGHTER_CANDIDATE_VERSION, ALL_VOCATION_THROW_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                   DISTANCE_AUDIO_CANDIDATE_VERSION):
        expected.update({'p2_enemy_health_bars': '1', 'p2_ally_health_bars': '0'})
    seen = set()
    section = ''
    legacy = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        row = line.split(';', 1)[0].split('#', 1)[0].strip(' \t\r')
        if row.startswith('[') and row.endswith(']'):
            section = row[1:-1].strip(' \t\r').lower()
        key, separator, value = row.partition('=')
        key = key.strip(' \t\r').lower()
        expected_section = 'recovery' if key in ('shared_lives', 'shared_life_count') else 'feedback'
        if version in (HEALTH_BARS_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       SHARED_LIFE_FOLLOWUP_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       NPC_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_VERSION, CAMERA_FIGHTER_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       ALL_VOCATION_THROW_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                       DISTANCE_AUDIO_CANDIDATE_VERSION) and key in ('p2_enemy_health_bars', 'p2_ally_health_bars'):
            is_candidate_setting = section == expected_section and bool(separator)
        else:
            is_candidate_setting = section == 'recovery' and key in expected and bool(separator)
        if is_candidate_setting and key in expected:
            if key in seen or value.strip(' \t\r') != expected[key]:
                raise ValueError(f'{version} player settings require one default {section}.{key}={expected[key]}')
            seen.add(key)
            legacy.append(f'; {version} default validated separately')
        else:
            legacy.append(line)
    if seen != set(expected):
        raise ValueError(f'{version} player settings require all explicit candidate defaults')
    if version in (HORIZONTAL_SPLIT_CANDIDATE_VERSION, NPC_INTERACTION_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                  CAMERA_FIGHTER_CANDIDATE_VERSION, ALL_VOCATION_THROW_CANDIDATE_VERSION,
                  DISTANCE_AUDIO_CANDIDATE_VERSION):
        section = ''
        layouts = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            row = line.split(';', 1)[0].split('#', 1)[0].strip(' \t\r')
            if row.startswith('[') and row.endswith(']'):
                section = row[1:-1].strip(' \t\r').lower()
            key, separator, value = row.partition('=')
            if (section == 'camera' and separator and
                    key.strip(' \t\r').lower() == 'split_layout'):
                layouts.append(value.strip(' \t\r').lower())
        if layouts != ['vertical']:
            raise ValueError(f'{version} player settings require one default camera.split_layout=vertical')
    installer._assert_player_settings('\n'.join(legacy))


def _object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError(f'Duplicate acceptance JSON key: {key}')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _acceptance(path, pin, payloads, version, public):
    if path is None or pin is None:
        raise ValueError('Candidate/release requires a pinned acceptance record')
    raw = _read_pin(path, pin, 'Acceptance record')
    record = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), object_pairs_hook=_object)
    if not isinstance(record, dict) or type(record.get('schema')) is not int or record['schema'] != 1:
        raise ValueError('Acceptance record must use schema 1')
    loader = dict(kind='xinput1_3', name='xinput1_3.dll', sha256=_sha(payloads['xinput1_3.dll']), version=version)
    expected = dict(status='passed', game_sha256=installer.GAME_SHA, loader=loader,
                    runtime_sha256=_sha(payloads['ddcoop_runtime.dll']), runtime_version=version,
                    runtime_build_id=RUNTIME_BUILD_ID, public_redistribution=public,
                    supported_p2_vocations=list(installer.SUPPORTED_P2_VOCATIONS))
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if record.get(key) != value or (key == 'public_redistribution' and type(record.get(key)) is not bool):
            raise ValueError(f'Acceptance {key} mismatch')
    physical = record.get('physical_controller_acceptance')
    statuses = ('unverified', 'partial', 'passed') if public else ('unverified',)
    if (not isinstance(physical, dict) or physical.get('status') not in statuses or
            not isinstance(physical.get('disclosure'), str) or not physical['disclosure'].strip()):
        raise ValueError('Acceptance requires physical-controller status and disclosure')
    profile = record.get('compatibility_profile')
    if not isinstance(profile, str) or not profile.strip():
        raise ValueError('Acceptance requires explicit tested compatibility_profile')
    return dict(record_sha256=_sha(raw), **expected,
                compatibility_profile=profile.strip(), physical_controller_acceptance=physical)


def stage(loader, runtime, settings, guide, out, zip_out, receipt_out, *,
          loader_sha256, runtime_sha256, settings_sha256, guide_sha256,
          version=VERSION, private_candidate=False, public_release=False,
          acceptance_record=None, acceptance_sha256=None, launcher=None, launcher_sha256=None):
    installer._validate_version(version)
    if version != VERSION and not (public_release and version == RELEASE_1_6_VERSION) and not (
            private_candidate and not public_release and version in PRIVATE_CANDIDATE_VERSIONS):
        raise ValueError(f'Unreviewed release version or distribution mode: {version}')
    if private_candidate and public_release:
        raise ValueError('Candidate/public modes are mutually exclusive')
    if not (private_candidate or public_release) and (acceptance_record is not None or acceptance_sha256 is not None):
        raise ValueError('Acceptance requires candidate/public mode')
    out = Path(out)
    zip_destination = installer._validate_zip_destination(out, Path(zip_out))
    receipt = Path(receipt_out).resolve()
    if receipt == out.resolve() or out.resolve() in receipt.parents or receipt == zip_destination:
        raise ValueError('Private receipt must be outside the stage and ZIP')
    if receipt.suffix.lower() != '.json' or not receipt.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Private receipt needs a .json path with existing parent')
    if receipt.exists() or out.exists():
        raise FileExistsError('Refusing to overwrite staging directory or private receipt')
    if not out.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Staging parent directory must already exist')
    source_paths = (loader, runtime, settings, guide)
    pins = (loader_sha256, runtime_sha256, settings_sha256, guide_sha256)
    payloads = {name: _read_pin(path, pin, name) for name, path, pin in zip(OUTPUT_NAMES, source_paths, pins)}
    if _pe_exports(payloads['xinput1_3.dll'], 'Loader') != EXPORTS:
        raise ValueError('Loader exports differ from reviewed exact name/ordinal contract')
    runtime_exports = _pe_exports(payloads['ddcoop_runtime.dll'], 'Runtime')
    if not {'CoopInitialize', 'CoopRuntimeBuildIdentity'} <= set(runtime_exports.values()):
        raise ValueError('Runtime requires CoopInitialize and CoopRuntimeBuildIdentity exports')
    _player_settings(payloads['ddcoop.ini'], version)
    _guide(payloads['README.txt'], version)
    if (launcher is None) != (launcher_sha256 is None):
        raise ValueError('Launcher path and SHA-256 must be supplied together')
    if launcher is not None:
        if version == RELEASE_1_6_VERSION:
            raise ValueError('1.6.0 public release is launcher-free')
        if version not in (VERSION, PRIVATE_CANDIDATE_VERSION) or not (private_candidate or public_release):
            raise ValueError('Launcher packaging is reviewed only for 1.5.0 candidate/release modes')
        raw = _read_pin(launcher, launcher_sha256, 'Launcher')
        if len(raw) < 256 or raw[:2] != b'MZ':
            raise ValueError('Launcher must be a managed Windows executable')
        pe, = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0x3c)
        if pe > len(raw) - 248 or raw[pe:pe+4] != b'PE\0\0':
            raise ValueError('Invalid launcher executable header')
        machine, = struct.unpack_from('<H', raw, pe+4)
        flags, = struct.unpack_from('<H', raw, pe+22)
        if (machine != 0x14c or flags & 0x2000 or
                struct.unpack_from('<H', raw, pe+24)[0] != 0x10b or
                struct.unpack_from('<H', raw, pe+24+68)[0] != 2 or
                struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, pe+24+208)[0] == 0):
            raise ValueError('Launcher must be a managed x86 Windows GUI executable')
        if 'CoopOnlineModeSupported' not in runtime_exports.values():
            raise ValueError('Launcher requires an online-mode-aware runtime')
        payloads['DDDA-Coop-Launcher.exe'] = raw
    acceptance = None
    if private_candidate or public_release:
        acceptance = _acceptance(acceptance_record, acceptance_sha256, payloads, version, public_release)
        record = json.loads(_read_pin(acceptance_record, acceptance_sha256, 'Acceptance record').decode('utf-8-sig'))
        if launcher is None and (record.get('launcher_omitted') is not True or 'launcher_sha256' in record):
            raise ValueError('Launcher-free release requires explicit acceptance without a launcher pin')
        if launcher is not None:
            record = json.loads(_read_pin(acceptance_record, acceptance_sha256, 'Acceptance record').decode('utf-8-sig'))
            if record.get('launcher_sha256') != launcher_sha256:
                raise ValueError('Acceptance launcher SHA-256 mismatch')
    status = installer.PUBLIC_STATUS if public_release else installer.PRIVATE_STATUS if private_candidate else 'internal-rehearsal-only'
    hashes = {name: _sha(data) for name, data in payloads.items()}
    verification = dict(schema=1, version=version, package_kind='xinput-drop-in',
                        distribution_status=status, public_release=public_release,
                        release_candidate=private_candidate, game_sha256=installer.GAME_SHA,
                        loader=dict(kind='xinput1_3', name='xinput1_3.dll', sha256=hashes['xinput1_3.dll'], version=version),
                        runtime_version=version, runtime_build_id=RUNTIME_BUILD_ID,
                        payload_sha256=hashes,
                        pe_inspection='x86 PE32 exports only; runtime build identity is verified by native acceptance',
                        source_paths={name: str(Path(path).resolve()) for name, path in zip(OUTPUT_NAMES, source_paths)})
    if acceptance is not None:
        verification['acceptance'] = acceptance
    if launcher is not None:
        verification['source_paths']['DDDA-Coop-Launcher.exe'] = str(Path(launcher).resolve())
    # Every rejection above happens before creating any output. Writes are exclusive.
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for name, data in payloads.items():
        with (out / name).open('xb') as output:
            output.write(data)
        if (out / name).read_bytes() != data:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Staging copy mismatch: {name}')
    installer._write_archive(zip_destination, payloads)
    verification['archive_sha256'] = _sha(zip_destination.read_bytes())
    with receipt.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as output:
        output.write(json.dumps(verification, indent=2) + '\n')
    result = dict(staged=str(out.resolve()), zip=str(zip_destination), receipt=str(receipt),
                  files=list(payloads), verification=verification)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('loader', 'runtime', 'settings', 'guide', 'out'):
        parser.add_argument(name, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--zip-out', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--receipt-out', required=True, type=Path)
    for name in ('loader', 'runtime', 'settings', 'guide'):
        parser.add_argument(f'--{name}-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--version', default=VERSION)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument('--private-candidate', action='store_true')
    mode.add_argument('--public-release', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--acceptance-record', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--acceptance-sha256')
    parser.add_argument('--launcher', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--launcher-sha256')
    stage(**vars(parser.parse_args()))

"""Held bow-slot inputs across interruption; live synthetic providers only."""
import argparse,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('trace',type=Path);p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
t=json.loads(a.trace.read_text())['value'];rows=t['rows'];phases=t['phases']
def phase(name,margin=300):
 i=next(i for i,x in enumerate(phases) if x['name']==name);end=phases[i+1]['time'] if i+1<len(phases) else float('inf')
 return [s for s in rows if phases[i]['time']+margin<=s['time']<end]
def every(xs,f):return bool(xs) and all(f(x) for x in xs)
held=phase('resumed_held' if t['pause'] else 'joined_held',600)
checks={
 'finished_cleanly':not t['running'] and not t['errors'] and len(phases)==13,
 'offline_and_health_retained':every(rows,lambda s:s['runtime']['nativeOffline']==1 and s['runtime']['transport']==2 and s['runtime']['nativeErrors']==s['runtime']['faults']==s['bow']['failures']==s['split']['faults']==s['hud']['failures']==0),
 'initial_all_held_inputs_blocked':every(phase('initial_held',700),lambda s:s['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']==8 and s['aim']['releaseShot']==1 and s['aim']['slot']==-1),
 'release_clears_warning':every(phase('release_initial',400),lambda s:s['aim']['releaseShot']==0),
 'fresh_y_selects_slot_1':any(s['aim']['slot']==1 for s in phase('selected_y')),
 'interrupted_held_inputs_do_not_fire':every(held,lambda s:s['runtime']['session']==2 and not(s['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']&0x29383)),
 'fresh_draw_recovers':every(phase('fresh_draw',900),lambda s:s['aim']['visible']==s['aim']['ready']==1 and s['aim']['releaseShot']==0),
 'fresh_b_selects_slot_2':any(s['aim']['slot']==2 for s in phase('selected_b')),
 'cancel_hides_aim':every(phase('cancel',1000),lambda s:s['aim']['visible']==s['bow']['ready']==0 and s['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']==0),
 'p1_no_bow_input_leak':every(rows,lambda s:not(s['runtime']['actors'][0]['held']&0x2938b)),
}
if t['pause']:
 checks['pause_hides_pawn_ui']=every(phase('paused',500),lambda s:s['runtime']['session']==3 and not s['split']['active'] and not s['aim']['visible'])
 checks['held_resume_draw_suppressed']=every(held,lambda s:s['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']==0)
else:
 checks['disconnect_restores_solo']=every(phase('disconnect',500),lambda s:s['runtime']['p2']==-1 and not s['split']['active'])
 checks['reconnect_needs_explicit_join']=every(phase('reconnect_held'),lambda s:s['runtime']['p2']==-1 and not s['split']['active'])
 checks['rejoin_held_warning']=every(held,lambda s:s['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']==8 and s['aim']['releaseShot']==1)
r={'pass':all(checks.values()),'checks':checks,'pid':t['pid'],'pause':t['pause'],'trace':a.trace.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.trace.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'scope':'X/Y/B/RT held across native pause or synthetic disconnect/rejoin; compiled runtime only','physical_controller_acceptance':False}
a.out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2));raise SystemExit(0 if r['pass'] else 1)

"""Compiled AI-to-controller handoff acceptance, separate from temporary probes."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('trace',type=Path);p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--implementation',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
w=json.loads(a.trace.read_bytes());assert w['ok'];d=w['value'];t=d['trial'];rows=t['rows'];base=t['baseline'];checks={}
every=lambda rs,f:bool(rs) and all(f(x) for x in rs)
joins=[p for p in t['phases'] if p['name']=='join_during_known_generic']
joined=[x for x in rows if joins and x['time']>=joins[0]['time'] and x['runtime']['session']==2 and x['runtime']['generation']>t['initial']['generation']]
steady=[x for x in joined if x['time']>=joined[0]['time']+500]
ai=[x for x in rows if x['runtime']['session']==1 and x['runtime']['actors'][1]['action']==242]
end=t.get('final',{});g=end.get('generic',base)
delta={k:g[k]-base[k] for k in ['requests','knownRequests','bindings','completions','cleanups']}
idle=next((x['time']-joined[0]['time'] for x in joined if x['runtime']['actors'][1]['action']==0),None)
completed=[x for x in rows if x['generic']['completions']>base['completions']]
cleaned=[x for x in rows if x['generic']['cleanups']>base['cleanups']]
checks['bounded_clean_finished']=not t['running'] and not t['errors'] and 0<len(rows)<=2600
checks['one_adaptive_join']=len(joins)==1
checks['known_ai_action_observed']=every(ai,lambda x:x['generic']['active']==1 and x['generic']['bindings']>base['bindings'] and x['generic']['knownRequests']>base['knownRequests'])
checks['ai_not_prematurely_completed']=every(ai,lambda x:x['generic']['completions']==base['completions'])
checks['one_request_binding_completion_cleanup']=all(delta[k]==1 for k in ['knownRequests','bindings','completions','cleanups'])
checks['healthy_offline_and_split']=every(rows,lambda x:x['runtime']['faults']==x['runtime']['nativeErrors']==x['split']['faults']==0 and x['runtime']['transport']==2 and x['runtime']['nativeOffline']==1)
checks['new_control_generation']=every(joined,lambda x:x['runtime']['generation']==t['initial']['generation']+2)
checks['idle_within_200ms']=idle is not None and idle<=200
checks['completion_at_handoff']=bool(joined and completed) and -50<=completed[0]['time']-joined[0]['time']<=200
checks['native_cleanup_within_200ms']=bool(completed and cleaned) and 0<=cleaned[0]['time']-completed[0]['time']<=200
checks['owned_neutral_intent']=every(joined,lambda x:x['runtime']['actors'][1]['held']==x['runtime']['actors'][1]['mode']==0)
checks['steady_idle']=every(steady,lambda x:x['runtime']['actors'][1]['action']==0)
motion=max((math.dist(x['runtime']['actors'][1]['pos'],steady[0]['runtime']['actors'][1]['pos']) for x in steady),default=None)
checks['steady_position']=motion is not None and motion<.01
checks['p1_stationary']=every(rows,lambda x:math.dist(x['runtime']['actors'][0]['pos'],t['initial']['actors'][0]['pos'])<.01)
checks['simulation_continues']=bool(joined) and joined[-1]['runtime']['actors'][1]['frames']-joined[0]['runtime']['actors'][1]['frames']>100
checks['steady_split']=every(steady,lambda x:x['split']['active']==1)
checks['no_candidate_left']=g['active']==0
checks['final_joined_idle']=bool(end) and end['runtime']['session']==2 and end['runtime']['actors'][1]['action']==0
checks['providers_neutral']=all(x.get('buttons',0)==0 for x in d['devices'])
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out={'compiled_handoff_pass':all(checks.values()),'checks':checks,'pid':t['pid'],'recorded_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'trace_sha256':sha(a.trace),'trial_sha256':sha('research/generic_runtime_trial.js'),'runtime_sha256':sha('../ddcoop_runtime.dll'),'game_sha256':sha('../DDDA.exe'),
 'implementation':a.implementation,'measurements':{'samples':len(rows),'owned_samples':len(joined),'ai_generic_samples':len(ai),'idle_after_ms':idle,'steady_motion':motion,'counter_delta':delta},
 'scope':'Compiled animation-19 handoff from a witnessed native pawn AI request; synthetic controller providers',
 'limits':['No temporary hooks/mutations in this trial','Full travel gate, native scripted/prebuilt sources, scene and failure-path live acceptance remain open','Does not pass S3/S4/S6 or physical two-controller acceptance']}
a.out.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'compiled_handoff_pass':out['compiled_handoff_pass'],'checks':len(checks),'failed':[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v],'measurements':out['measurements']},indent=2));raise SystemExit(0 if out['compiled_handoff_pass'] else 1)

  "src/buffer.c"
  "src/hook.c"
  "src/trampoline.c"
)

  set(SOURCES_HDE "src/hde/hde64.c")
else()
  set(SOURCES_HDE "src/hde/hde32.c")
endif()

if(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
  set(RESOURCES 
    "dll_resources/MinHook.rc"
    "dll_resources/MinHook.def"
  )
endif()

add_library(minhook ${SOURCES_MINHOOK} ${SOURCES_HDE} ${RESOURCES})

target_include_directories(minhook PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

target_include_directories(minhook PRIVATE "src/")
target_include_directories(minhook PRIVATE "src/hde/")

if(WIN32)
  set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
  if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)

    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES RELEASE_POSTFIX ".x64")
    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES RELWITHDEBINFO_POSTFIX ".x64")
    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES MINSIZEREL_POSTFIX ".x64")

    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES DEBUG_POSTFIX ".x32d")
    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES RELEASE_POSTFIX ".x32")
    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES RELWITHDEBINFO_POSTFIX ".x32")
    set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES MINSIZEREL_POSTFIX ".x32")
  endif()
else()
  set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES PREFIX "lib")
  set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES POSTFIX "")
  set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES DEBUG_POSTFIX "d")
endif()

################
# CMAKE CONFIG # 
################

configure_package_config_file(
    "cmake/minhook-config.cmake.in"
    "minhook-config.cmake"
  INSTALL_DESTINATION 
    "lib/minhook"
)

write_basic_package_version_file(
  "minhook-config-version.cmake"
VERSION 
  ${MINHOOK_VERSION}
COMPATIBILITY
  AnyNewerVersion
)

install(
  FILES 
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/minhook-config.cmake"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/minhook-config-version.cmake"
  DESTINATION 
    "lib/minhook"
)

###################
#     INSTALL     #
###################

install(TARGETS minhook
        EXPORT minhook-targets
        RUNTIME DESTINATION "bin"
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION "lib"
        LIBRARY DESTINATION "lib"
)

install(
  EXPORT
    minhook-targets
  NAMESPACE 
    minhook::
  DESTINATION 
    "lib/minhook"
)

install(
  DIRECTORY include DESTINATION .
)
